viewing_check: Read the maker name and model on the lamp (body, door, burner, generator base) and any stamp such as P&H, Lucas, Miller, Solar; check lens and jewel intact and generator complete. Also photograph the gauge dial maker name and any stove maker mark on tank or burner.
